name: programme
title: Programme readiness
subtitle: Internal working schedule. Sign-off checks recorded evidence; it is not permission to exhibit.

sections.title: Screenings
sections.sql: select code,film,venue,local_start,timezone,readiness,array_to_string(blockers,'; ') as issues from v_release order by starts,code

sections.title: Room conflicts
sections.sql: select code,venue,conflicts_with,reason from v_conflicts order by code

sections.title: Selection meeting
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,status,reviews,average_score,screenings from v_selection order by code

sections.title: Copy traffic
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due,format,attention from v_delivery order by due nulls first,code

sections.title: Guests
sections.sql: select code,name,purpose,review_due from guests order by code

sections.title: Conflicting commitments
sections.sql: select * from v_guest_conflicts order by code

sections.title: Recorded control gaps
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by record,rule
